2124538288975601711.en_summary: This is a great visual of how much of the AI data center buildout is already underway versus how much still faces political hurdles. $AMZN has largest AI data center pipeline in America but ~80% of what AWS has announced and not yet started building sits in states classified as restrictive or hostile creating potential permitting delays, higher power costs and project relocations. Meanwhile $META and $GOOGL already have 15 GW and 13 GW under construction against just 6 GW and 7 GW currently active putting them further along in their next wave of expansion. $ORCL has opposite challenge with 6 GW under construction against just 1 GW active but almost nothing announced beyond that. Everyone keeps comparing how much AI capacity these companies have planned but real advantage in 2027 will be who can actually get it built and connected to the grid.
2124538288975601711.zh_summary: 這是一個很好的視覺呈現，顯示 AI 數據中心建設已進行多少與仍面臨政治障礙的程度。$AMZN 在美國擁有最大 AI 數據中心管道，但 AWS 已宣布但尚未開始建設的約 80% 位於被分類為限制或敵對的州，可能造成許可延遲、更高電力成本與項目搬遷。同時 $META 和 $GOOGL 已有 15 GW 和 13 GW 在建設中，而目前活躍僅 6 GW 和 7 GW，使他們在下一波擴張中更進一步。$ORCL 面臨相反挑戰，6 GW 在建設中對比僅 1 GW 活躍，但幾乎沒有更多宣布。人人都在比較這些公司計劃的 AI 容量，但 2027 年的真正優勢將是誰能實際建成並連接到電網。
